d:
Sri Rama Rajyam Tamil Movie Songs, Jagadananda Karaka Song HD, featuring Balakrishna and Nayanthara. Music by Ilayaraja and directed by Bapu. Sri Ramarajyam stars Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Srikanth, KR Vijaya and Roja in pivotal roles.
Song : Jagadananda Karaka / Jagadanandakaraka
Singers : SPB, Chinmayi Sripada
Sri Rama Rajyam Tamil Movie also stars Murali Mohan, Master Gaurav and Master Dhanush Kumar among others. The devotional film is produced by Yalamanchili Sai Babu and is dubbed from the Telugu movie of the same name.
Thambula Ragangal Song | Sri Rama Rajyam Tamil Songs
